title: How Inference Keeps Up with Our Insatiable Need for Tokens — Cerebras & Gimlet Labs
talk_summary: A Cerebras and Gimlet Labs talk explaining inference-level optimizations (batching, paged KV cache, prompt caching, chunked prefill, prefill/decode disaggregation, speculative decoding) and how they shift the speed/throughput Pareto frontier.

takeaways.what_they_do: Reuse the KV cache computed for a prior request's long system prompt instead of recomputing prefill each time, skipping the compute-bound prefill phase.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can reuse the KV cache that you calculated already for the previous request for the next request

takeaways.technique: Chunked prefill to avoid pipeline clogging
takeaways.what_they_do: Long-context requests monopolize the inference pipeline during prefill, blocking other requests; chunking the prefill interleaves decode and prefill so one huge request doesn't stall everything.
takeaways.evidence_quote: While prefill is running, no other prefill or decode request can get through.

takeaways.technique: Speculative decoding with a draft model
takeaways.what_they_do: A small draft model proposes candidate tokens that the full model verifies, cutting the number of full-model forward passes needed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: with speculative decode, you actually only needed to run it three times on that full model
takeaways.numbers: 9 full-model passes reduced to 3 for 9 tokens

takeaways.what_they_do: Classify each request by whether it is prefill/compute-bound (long prompt, short answer) or decode/memory-bound (short prompt, long output) and route to the hardware best suited for that phase.
takeaways.numbers: 3-10x faster inference vs homogeneous systems at same power budget

takeaways.what_they_do: An agent brute-forces kernel optimization given hardware and workload profiles, improving already-optimized kernels.
takeaways.evidence_quote: within that time it was able to speed up GPT-OSS-120B on AMD hardware by 33% end-to-end
takeaways.numbers: 33% end-to-end speedup on GPT-OSS-120B on AMD in under a week
